parsed.main_gap: Lemma 1 relies on a false unbounded infinite-sunflower assertion; only the bounded-cardinality version needed later is valid and must be proved.

errors.description: The stated sunflower fact is false for finite sets of unbounded size (for example, strictly growing initial segments). The sketched induction need not terminate. The argument can be repaired locally by restricting Lemma 1 to transversals of size at most K and inducting on K, which is all the later proof uses.
